info.description: Bounded simulator subset of the official Amazon Appflow API (2020-08-23). Every other official operation returns HTTP 501 UnknownOperationException. Flows are stored definitions: nothing is ever transferred, so no flow runs, no execution or run history exists, lastRunExecutionDetails is never reported and a flow is Active at once. StartFlow, StopFlow, CancelFlowExecutions, DescribeFlowExecutionRecords, RegisterConnector and every other official operation return UnknownOperationException with HTTP 501. Connector profiles hold third-party credentials and are not implemented, so no connector profile name is accepted: the source and every destination must be an Amazon S3 location (connectorType S3) without connectorProfileName, exactly one destination is allowed, and an Event trigger is refused because no event source exists. Tasks, bucket names, schedules and the KMS key are stored without being resolved or checked against Amazon S3. UpdateFlow replaces the supplied members and keeps those it omits, including description and metadataCatalogConfig, and a flow is deleted whether or not forceDelete is sent. ListFlows summaries carry no sourceConnectorType, destinationConnectorType or triggerType, because the stored model has no member to hold them. Tags are stored from CreateFlow and by TagResource on the flow ARN. The limit of 100 flows per Region is local.
